# Zonai

> A batteries-included Dart backend framework — schema-driven REST API, auth, SQLite, **live query streams**, file uploads, cron jobs, and more.

Zonai turns Dart schema, rules, and business logic into a production HTTP + SQLite server. You host the binary yourself (not a managed cloud BaaS). Docs: https://docs.zonai.dev/ — source: https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/zonai

**Live UI:** every table has `GET /db/stream`, `/db/stream/list`, `/db/stream/count`. Prefer `zonai_client` → `client.db.listen`. In this codebase the feature is named **stream** / **listen**. Guide: https://docs.zonai.dev/operations/streaming

The docs site has full-text search (press ⌘K / Ctrl+K on any page); the same corpus is available as JSON at https://docs.zonai.dev/search-index.json — one record per page, split by heading, with the anchor for each section.

This file is a curated index for LLMs and coding agents. Prefer these pages over guessing APIs. For project-local assistant rules, run `zonai ai cursor` (or `claude` / `copilot` / `windsurf` / `cline`) from an app root.

## Critical facts for agents

- **Package split**: `zonai_schema` (pub.dev dependency — tables, rules, ops types) and the optional `zonai_client` (pub.dev). The `zonai` CLI is **not** on pub.dev: it is a pre-compiled binary downloaded from https://zonai.dev and placed in the project root, invoked as `./zonai`.
- **Runtime**: `zonai serve` / `zonai build` produce a **project-linked binary** with operations + rules **in-process**. Workers under `.zonai/executables/` handle config, extensions, rate limits, and crons (IPC via MessagePack). Hot path: Rate limit → Rules → Operations → SQLite → Extensions → Response.
- **CRUD shape**: table name is in the JSON body (or `?body=` for GET), **never** in the URL path. Endpoints: `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /db`, `/db/list`, `/db/count`, `/db/many`, plus live **`/db/stream`**, `/db/stream/list`, `/db/stream/count`.
- **Live queries**: long-lived HTTP streams push updates when SQLite results change. Client API: `client.db.listen.one|list|count` with `StreamBody` / `StreamListBody` / `StreamCountBody`.
- **Where filters**: docs/curl shorthand `{ "id": { "eq": "…" } }` is accepted. Canonical wire form is `{ "type": "eq", "column": "id", "value": "…" }`. Both work.
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. Bodies include `"table": "users"` (or whatever auth table). Mixins: `PasswordAuth`, `OtpAuth`, `MagicLinkAuth`, optional `AsAdmin`.
- **Client**: prefer shipping `zonai_client` (auth, admin auth, db + listen, photos, email) over hand-rolled `package:http`.
- **Typed client**: `zonai gen client` generates per-table APIs from the schema — `client.posts.list(...)` → `PostsRow`, instead of `client.db.list(body: ListBody(table: 'posts'), fromJson: …)`. It is an **extension** on `ZonaiClient`, so both styles are valid in one file. It needs a `client:` block in `zonai.yaml` whose `output` is **required with no default** (the server project cannot be an app dependency, so the destination belongs to the app). It emits reads (`get`/`list`/`count`), writes (`create`/`createMany`/`update`/`updateMany`/`delete`/`deleteMany`) and live queries (`client.posts.listen.*`), with column tokens for filters (`Posts.title.eq('x')`, `Posts.body.isNull`) and typed `expand` paths. Update fields take a `Patch`, so `Field.clear()` sets NULL and omission leaves alone. An enum column gets its own type -- an extension type over `String` with named constants (`BooksShelf.reading`), not a Dart `enum`, so a member the server adds later still parses; use `.value` where a raw `String` is needed. Importing the generated barrel is enough to name the query vocabulary (`Where`, `Paginated`, `OrderByTerm`) -- it re-exports `zonai_client`. A view gets no write surface. `_`-prefixed system tables are skipped unless named in `client.tables.include`. `zonai gen client --check` fails when committed output is stale. https://docs.zonai.dev/cli/gen
- **Rules default deny**: unoverridden table/row/auth checks return false → HTTP 403 before SQL. Streams reuse `canView` / `canList` / `canCount`.
- **Dev vs prod**: `zonai dev` / `zonai serve` for local; `zonai build` ships `build/zonai` (asserts off). Restart `serve` after editing ops/rules so the linked entry reloads; workers hot-recompile on their own.
- **Migrations**: `zonai db migrate generate` then `apply` (or auto-migrate on serve). Commit `.zonai/migrations/`. Do not commit `.zonai/data/` or executables.
- **Compile-time env**: `.env` — or `.env.<flavor>` when `--flavor <name>` is passed — is read from the project root automatically and baked into the binaries via `String.fromEnvironment`. **There is no `--dart-define-from-file`**: the env file is never named on the command line. Per-key overrides are `--dart-define KEY=VALUE` (space-separated, not `--dart-define=KEY=VALUE`), repeated. Unrecognized flags are dropped silently, so guessing a flag name builds cleanly with **zero** defines injected. https://docs.zonai.dev/configuration/environment-variables
- **Optional runtime env**: `ZONAI_FORCE_WORKERS`, `ZONAI_WORKER_TRANSPORT` (`auto`|`process`|`isolate`), `ZONAI_WORKER_POOL_SIZE`, `ZONAI_HTTP_WORKERS` (keep `1` with one SQLite file).

- [How a Request is Processed](https://docs.zonai.dev/core-concepts/request-pipeline): Ordered pipeline and in-process vs worker boundaries.

## Configuration

- [zonai.yaml Reference](https://docs.zonai.dev/configuration/zonai-yaml): Paths, version, server settings, and the `client:` block for `zonai gen client`.
- [App Config](https://docs.zonai.dev/configuration/app-config): `AppConfig` — `baseUrl`, JWT secret, SMTP, photos, workers.
- [Environment Variables](https://docs.zonai.dev/configuration/environment-variables): Compile-time `.env` secrets, `--dart-define` overrides (there is no `--dart-define-from-file`), and optional `ZONAI_*` runtime tuning.

- [Photo Tables](https://docs.zonai.dev/schemas/photo-tables): Built-in `_photos` and photo columns.

- [Operations Overview](https://docs.zonai.dev/operations/overview): Default vs custom operations; when to override SQL.

- [Streaming (Live Queries)](https://docs.zonai.dev/operations/streaming): `/db/stream*` and `client.db.listen`.
- [Auth Operations](https://docs.zonai.dev/operations/auth-operations): JWT claims, reset/OTP/magic-link URL paths.

## Rules (authorization)

- [Rules Overview](https://docs.zonai.dev/rules/overview): Two-layer model (table then row); default deny.
- [Table Rules](https://docs.zonai.dev/rules/table-rules): Per-operation allow/deny from JWT.
- [Row Rules](https://docs.zonai.dev/rules/row-rules): Per-row checks; `requiresPerRowCheck`.
- [Auth Rules](https://docs.zonai.dev/rules/auth-rules): Sign-up, sign-in, password reset gates.
- [JWT Claims](https://docs.zonai.dev/rules/jwt-claims): Built-in claims and `addClaims`.
- [Photo Rules](https://docs.zonai.dev/rules/photo-rules): Upload/view/delete photo access.

## Authentication

- [Authentication Overview](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/overview): JWT model, multi-table auth, response shape.
- [Password Auth](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/password-auth): Email/password + Argon2id.
- [OTP Auth](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/otp-auth): Email one-time codes.
- [Magic Link Auth](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/magic-link-auth): Passwordless emailed links.
- [Session Management](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/session-management): Refresh, logout, JWT lifetime.
- [Admin Accounts](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/admin-accounts): `zonai db admin`, `AsAdmin`, elevated claims.
- [API Tokens](https://docs.zonai.dev/authentication/api-tokens): `zonai db token`, opaque `zonai_pat_` credentials with no sign-in and no expiry, scoped and revocable.

## Push notifications

Firebase Cloud Messaging. Recipients are named by a **query over a `$.deviceToken` column**, never a list of tokens: `await push(message, table: 'device_tokens', column: 'token', where: In('user_id', ids))`. Returns a `PushJobId` as soon as the job is durably recorded — **not** a delivery receipt, and not awaitable to completion. Call from `after*` hooks only. Requires `AppConfig.push`; without it the call throws. Zonai clears tokens FCM reports dead (`onPermanentRejection`, default `clearColumn`) and fires `onPushRejected` first.

- [Push Overview](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/overview): What Zonai owns, and why setup needs an APNs key even though you only integrate FCM.
- [Device Tokens](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/device-tokens): The `$.deviceToken` column; it must be nullable and its table must have a primary key.
- [Push Configuration](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/configuration): `PushConfig`, and why `.file` credentials beat `.inline` (rotation is a file copy, not a rebuild).
- [Sending](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/sending): `PushMessage`, collapse keys, and what the job id does and does not promise.
- [Dead Tokens](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/dead-tokens): Pruning policy, the hook, and why a timeout is not a death.
- [Delivery Guarantees](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/delivery-guarantees): At-least-once, duplicates bounded by one batch, and the transient failures that are not retried across passes.
- [Testing Push Locally](https://docs.zonai.dev/push/testing-locally): FCM has no sandbox; how to run the whole path against a local stand-in, and what that still cannot prove.

- [zonai ai](https://docs.zonai.dev/cli/ai): Install LLM reference sheets into a project.

- [zonai gen](https://docs.zonai.dev/cli/gen): Generate a typed Dart client from the schema; `--check` for CI.
- [Upgrading Zonai](https://docs.zonai.dev/cli/upgrading): Moving between releases, including breaking upgrades.
- [Global Flags](https://docs.zonai.dev/cli/global-flags): `--flavor`, `--release`, `--config`, log levels — and why an unrecognized flag is ignored instead of rejected.

## Dashboard (admin UI)

Served at `/_` by every Zonai server, in dev and production alike; there is no flag to disable it. Requires an admin JWT (`isAdmin`), created with `zonai db admin`. Routes: `/_` metrics, `/_/tables`, `/_/tables/<table>`, `/_/sign-in`.

- [Dashboard Overview](https://docs.zonai.dev/dashboard/overview): Access, admin sign-in, and not exposing `/_` publicly.
- [Metrics & Cron Jobs](https://docs.zonai.dev/dashboard/metrics): 24h requests, error rate, active sessions, top errors, manual cron runs.
- [Browsing & Editing Data](https://docs.zonai.dev/dashboard/table-editor): Row grid with typed editors and foreign-key pickers. Edits fire extensions and push to live queries.

## Optional example shapes

Create:

```json
{ "table": "tasks", "object": { "title": "Buy groceries", "isComplete": false } }
```

List with where (shorthand):

```
GET /db/list?body={"table":"tasks","where":{"isComplete":{"eq":false}},"limit":20}
```

Live stream one row (the connection stays open):

```
GET /db/stream?body={"table":"tasks","where":{"id":{"eq":"tk_abc123"}},"expand":[]}
```

Password sign-in:

```json
{ "table": "users", "email": "a@example.com", "password": "secret" }
```
